avgHr.name: Average heart rate

power.name: Power
power.desc: Pedal power right now, from a power meter.

power3s.name: Power, 3 s
power3s.desc: Average power over the last 3 seconds, steadier than the instant reading.

power10s.name: Power, 10 s
power10s.desc: Average power over the last 10 seconds.

normPower.name: Normalized power
normPower.desc: The steady power that would cost the same effort; fairer than the average on a varied ride.

powerZone.desc: Zone 1 to 7 from your power and FTP, in colour. Needs an FTP in settings.

estPower.name: Estimated power
estPower.desc: Power worked out from your speed, grade and weight. A rough guide when you have no power meter.

distanceToTurn.name: Distance to turn
distanceToTurn.desc: Distance to the next turn on the route. Needs a route.

movingTime.name: Moving time
movingTime.desc: Time you were actually moving; pauses do not count.

elapsedTime.name: Elapsed time
elapsedTime.desc: Time since you started, stops included.

eta.name: Arrival time
eta.desc: When you reach the finish at your current pace. Needs a route.

grade.name: Grade
grade.desc: The road grade now in percent, smoothed over about 150 m.

climbRemaining.name: Climb remaining
climbRemaining.desc: Metres still to climb on the next climb. Needs a route.

battery.name: Phone battery

mode.title: Mode
mode.hint: Use the bike computer screen when recording a ride
mode.body: While you record a ride with your phone, the screen becomes a bike computer: big numbers, data pages you can arrange, a map, climbs and alerts. It only applies to Ride; other sports keep the normal screen.

display.title: Display
display.themeHint: Day: a white background that reads in full sun. Night: a black background. Auto follows the app theme.
display.dimHint: The screen dims when untouched and wakes on a touch or an alert. Saves battery.
display.dimNote: Dimming needs the store build of the app. Older builds ignore this setting.

pages.title: Data pages
pages.body: Arrange the pages you swipe through while riding: how many numbers per page and which ones.

ride.title: Ride features
ride.autoPauseHint: Recording stops when you stop and resumes when you move again.
ride.autoLapHintStart: A new lap when you get back to the start point after riding away.
ride.offCourseHint: You are warned when you are farther than this from the route.

alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.hrHint: An alert when your heart rate leaves the zones you pick.
alerts.powerHint: An alert when your power leaves the zones you pick. Needs an FTP.
alerts.cadenceHint: An alert when your cadence goes under or over the limits.
alerts.vibrateHint: A vibration pattern for each alert.
alerts.soundHint: Sound through a notification. In-app beeps are not available yet.

hrSensor.title: Heart rate for a bike computer
hrSensor.hint: A bike computer pairs the phone as a Bluetooth heart-rate sensor and shows your watch's heart rate.
hrSensor.advertising: Waiting for a bike computer. Search for a Bluetooth heart-rate sensor on it.
hrSensor.noReading: no reading from the watch yet
hrSensor.battery: The bike computer also sees the phone's battery: {{value}}%
hrSensor.permission: JoyoFit needs the Nearby devices permission to act as a sensor.
hrSensor.failed: The sensor could not start. Check that Bluetooth is on.
hrSensor.unsupported: This phone cannot act as a Bluetooth sensor.
hrSensor.body: On the bike computer, add a heart-rate sensor over Bluetooth (not ANT+) and pick this phone; it shows under the phone's Bluetooth name. The watch keeps its connection to JoyoFit, and its heart rate is read only while the bike computer is connected. Keep background mode on so this keeps working with the screen off. Speed and distance come from the bike computer's own GPS.

editor.title: Data pages
editor.slotHint: Tap a number to change it.

specialNote.map: Map page: your position, the route and the next turn.
specialNote.climb: Climb page: the route elevation profile and the next climb. Needs a route.
specialNote.laps: Laps page: the running lap and the finished ones.

editor.resetMessage: The data pages go back to the default arrangement. Your current arrangement is lost.

battery.short: Battery is not enough for this route: it needs about {{need}} h, the battery lasts about {{have}} h
